**ClientSideCrystals**
---
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/A2Nx9kxDeB) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-1bd96a?logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/user/cutebow) [![Source](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source-181717?logo=github&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cutebow/Client-Side-Crystals)
--- Makes end crystals appear instantly on your screen the moment you place them no matter your ping - giving better looking crystaling and better timing feedback in crystalpvp. no packets are changed crystaling is still handled like normal. read below for more about what the mod does How it works in depth, Basiclly what it is doing is when you place a crystal it will put a fake client side crystal that looks real and depending on ur setting it will either seemlessly switch from the fake client side visual only crystal to the real one that was placed server side but the real crystal is fully unaffected. like placement and breaking is fully unaffected the goal of the mod is just supposed to give like the visuals of zero ping like no delay when placing but keep in mind its entirely visual hence the red like highlight in the gallery thats the tint setting which is to highlight the fake crystal to show like when it changes. you might have worries about things like would it mess up timing, to answer this not really and if you are really picky the tint option could help with that since it would tell you right as when it switches to the real crystal but mainly the mod is just to help with like confidence that your click infact did work and did place the crystal. when alot of the time you could accidently second guess yourself. If you are a player who is on high ping then you def should use this mod! as it helps a ton mentally. adds westshop.org to serverlist with an animated effect (can be removed) also adds an effect for napvp but that isnt added to the serverlist. as well as an updater to stay up to date on the latest version of the mod. Updates aren't posted often though, and when they are it's usually a big thing which was why it was added, or incase its a pretty major bug. with a simular animated effect with the text as the serverlist has. _It’s purely client-side and doesn’t change how crystals behave on the server, so it’s not a cheat or advantage mod, just a visual prediction and then it snaps back to the real crystal right as the server confirms the real one but it fills the gap of the crystal not existing so it looks instant._ Requires: - [Silicon](https://modrinth.com/mod/silicons/versions) - YACL Allowed on: - VTL (mctiers.com) - mcpvp.club - pvptiers.com (Lurrns tierlist) - napvp.us - westshop.org (In the serverlist) - catpvp - crystalranked - crackedpvp.club - applepvp.com - nova tiers - and more! Join the discord to get notified for new updates --- **1.21.11 and up recommended for best visuals (final version)** 0.16.0 Fabric loader and newer Please report any bugs in my discord. Works perfectly with Marlow’s Optimizer and other server-side optimizers, this includes server side optimizers that place/break crystals for you since you still see the real crystal and most of the time you're seeing the real crystal. this basiclly just bridges the gap between the crystal not existing and it existing ### FAQ - Is this cheats? No. crystals are still handled like vanilla this just places a client side crystal instantly for instant visual feedback. It looks "sus" or 'cheaty" but I can assure you that's only for you're pov for others it looks as if you were crystaling without it, it's the crystal disappearing and the actual crystal visually appearing they show up at a different height and rotation. Report any bugs to me as this is a very version fragile mod
